setup_action: Walk each advertised route/control with its documented prerequisites
expected_result: A real consequence or explicit unavailable/disabled reason; no inert enabled control. Record the request and persisted consequence.

setup_action: Compare guide claims with code, feature flags and latest delivery receipts
expected_result: Each claim has a source, candidate SHA, availability condition, known limit and proving case.

setup_action: Inspect disabled providers, demo builds and experimental features
expected_result: Unconfigured is distinct from stubbed; synthetic transport is test evidence, not a production provider. Mark a stub only with exact code evidence.

setup_action: Reconcile v0.4 work-model/Fabric and later voice/semantic roadmap
expected_result: Planned work retains its owning issue and actual milestone; no earlier release promise is inferred from shared terminology.

setup_action: Capture one known task through the UI/API proposal flow and request a proposal
expected_result: Capture is durable; proposal is reviewable; board card count remains N until explicit Apply.

setup_action: In UI/API, preview, approve, then explicitly apply the one-create proposal
expected_result: Preview and approval leave N cards; successful explicit Apply gives N+1 with correct text/destination and linked audit/provenance.

setup_action: Reject, lose permission, archive board or change proposal revision before apply
expected_result: No unauthorized/stale board mutation; visible recovery explains refresh/review; no silent reapproval or resend.

setup_action: Repeat UI/API apply after a lost receipt; inspect the available CLI and MCP commands separately
expected_result: UI/API retry resolves the saved outcome without a second created card. MCP proposal tools expose get/list/dismiss, not approve/apply. CLI card add/move directly call application services and require their own permission/retry expectations; do not replay an invented Apply operation.

setup_action: Switch through all four experiences with an open card and unsaved capture/chat/thinking
expected_result: Same account, route, card IDs and appropriate unsaved draft remain; zero proposal approval/apply or provider request solely from switching.

setup_action: Repeat one capture-think-review-resume scenario in each experience
expected_result: Expected task is completed with correct saved result; record time, misclicks, assistance, recovery attempts and participant explanation.

setup_action: Change Zen/Studio/Control and Grove/Grove Night, including Auto appearance
expected_result: Permission, due/blocker and trust information remain accessible; selected and resolved appearance attribution are accurate.

setup_action: Record, export and import the same comparison observations twice
expected_result: Stable IDs and configuration/build attribution survive; exact duplicates are skipped; conflicting IDs reject the batch rather than silently overwrite.

setup_action: Keyboard-only capture, card thinking, review, settings and nested confirmation
expected_result: Every intended control is reachable and named; focus is visible; no trap; Escape/close returns focus to the invoking control where contracted.

setup_action: Use a real screen reader for saving, validation, stale results and proposal decisions
expected_result: Names/roles/state changes and errors are announced meaningfully; recovery does not depend solely on color or visual location.

setup_action: Open card/nested confirmation with a physical mobile keyboard visible; rotate and zoom
expected_result: Focused fields and primary actions remain reachable; no obscured confirmation or lost draft; inspect real iOS Safari and Android Chrome separately from emulation.

setup_action: Audit Grove/Night, Paper/Legacy and reduced-motion/high-zoom states
expected_result: Measure the applicable WCAG 2.2 AA criteria (4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text/non-text where applicable); record exceptions and actual measurements, not a blanket certification.

setup_action: Save a steps layer, create one linked card, retry and remove the original step
expected_result: Exactly one card/link on retry; current status comes from the real card; removing the layer does not delete that card.

setup_action: Add a prerequisite, attempt a reverse edge/cycle, then export/import
expected_result: Valid edge appears in both directions; invalid cycle causes zero graph mutation; import remaps endpoints within the new board.

setup_action: Choose private plan/Focus, switch Board/List/Horizon, use Make room, reload
expected_result: Same real card references; plan/focus persists for its owner; Make room does not change card due dates or collaborators’ private plan.

setup_action: Exercise typed items/parent hierarchy/assignments/custom fields on a candidate that includes their owning implementation
expected_result: Apply each owning issue’s exact contract, ID/permission/archive/import rules and migrations; otherwise record BLOCKED on that issue, not PASS or stubbed.

setup_action: A and B answer the same shared question; C/D inspect board routes and exports
expected_result: Shared question may be visible by board permission; private answers/history never appear in another user’s response, board JSON or UI.

setup_action: Correct/archive/restore memory and preserve an older original
expected_result: Current value changes only as requested; immutable original and correction lineage remain readable by the owner; historical originals are clearly labelled.

setup_action: Explicitly select a memory/original for Companion, then change source or permission before send
expected_result: Only previewed selected content is eligible; stale/unauthorized content is rejected; no implicit private retrieval or model resend.

setup_action: Export account, erase A in an isolated fixture during pending reads/writes
expected_result: Owner’s private source graph, representations and receipts follow erasure policy; late work cannot resurrect it; B’s records survive.

setup_action: Record/upload valid audio, deny microphone access, use text fallback and retry a lost upload receipt
expected_result: Original playback/download is usable; permission failure offers an actionable path; stable retry does not duplicate the original.

setup_action: Inspect destination/model, consent once, receive provisional transcript, review and confirm
expected_result: No provider request before consent; source bytes and configured destination match; provisional text is not an answer until explicit confirmation; original remains unchanged.

setup_action: Preview one card excerpt and request grounded questions
expected_result: The model user content equals the previewed excerpt; bounded questions contain valid quoted evidence; stale evidence/permission/budget failures are explicit and do not auto-resend.

setup_action: Run an agreed synthetic/redacted corpus through an explicitly configured live route
expected_result: Record transcription errors, unsupported claims, useful/duplicate questions, corrections, latency and usage. Report actual outcomes and limitations; deterministic mocks alone cannot pass this row.

setup_action: Use a new account and eligible existing question; leave reminders disabled
expected_result: Zero reminder delivery and zero automatic model analysis. Opt-in is explicit.

setup_action: Enable reminders with typing/dialog/Focus/Zen/hidden-tab suppression; advance controlled clock
expected_result: No interruption in quiet states; at most two deliveries per UTC day and at least two hours between eligible deliveries across sessions.

setup_action: Save named-zone weekday/overnight hours and test DST, UTC rollover and enable-only toggles
expected_result: Window uses the configured IANA zone and starting day; toggles preserve saved window and unsaved edit draft; editing hours does not reset usage allowance.

setup_action: A save pending → switch to B → B edits/saves → A succeeds or fails → B finishes
expected_result: A’s completion cannot clear B’s guard; B’s draft remains; an explicit hours save uses B’s current revision exactly once.

setup_action: Upgrade a copied supported prior-release fixture using UPGRADING.md
expected_result: Migrations succeed or fail safely; card IDs/counts, private histories, links, plans, originals and receipts reconcile to the baseline.

setup_action: Restore a backup into an isolated instance using the existing runbook
expected_result: Restored counts/content and decryptability match; measured RPO/RTO and artifact hashes are recorded; original instance is untouched.

setup_action: Import board exports with linked thinking/dependencies and comparison v2/v3 files
expected_result: References remap within the new board; private answers stay excluded; duplicates/conflicting IDs follow the documented policy; unsupported formats fail visibly.

setup_action: Attempt corrupt/truncated/unsupported imports and interrupted migration/restore
expected_result: No partial unauthorized graph or silent data discard; recovery follows the documented transaction/backup boundary.

setup_action: Fresh browser follows the enabled registration/invitation mode and first capture-review-apply
expected_result: The documented user path works with clear setup/egress/cost disclosure; closed/invite-only modes reject unauthorized registration.

setup_action: A/B/D attempt cross-account object reads/writes, stale sessions and reconnect
expected_result: No cross-account private data or authority leakage; expired/revoked credentials fail visibly; reconnect does not duplicate writes.

setup_action: Exercise configured rate/cost/size ceilings and provider/storage outage
expected_result: Admission fails before prohibited work/charges; operator and user receive bounded useful signals; secrets and private payloads are absent from logs.

setup_action: Restore the isolated deployment and rehearse an incident/runbook handoff
expected_result: Documented recovery succeeds within measured/accepted objectives; status/contact/ownership and rollback evidence are real.

setup_action: Submit a supported source and execute the existing deterministic capability path
expected_result: Capture/source/job/run/representation lineage is durable and queryable under the owning contract; duplicate admission does not create unintended duplicate work.

setup_action: Restart/timeout/cancel a processor; expire a lease; replay a receipt
expected_result: State transitions, retry eligibility and visible recovery match the queue/worker contract; no ambiguous “success” or duplicate committed outcome.

setup_action: Feed maliciously oversized/compressed/unsupported input to the isolated processor harness
expected_result: Configured resource/capability limits stop processing; no uncontrolled child process or forbidden filesystem/network effect.

setup_action: Inspect/export evidence anchors after representation migration or source deletion
expected_result: Anchors resolve to the intended typed source/version or clearly report unavailability; private/account boundaries and documented retention remain intact.
